directions: Use case: stylized-concept. Design an ORIGINAL friendly superhero named Aster, unrelated to existing franchises: a gentle purple-skinned cosmic hero with short deep-blue hair dotted with tiny pale speckles, bright gold eyes, midnight-blue high-collar suit with a coral starflower badge. Charming big-head chibi comic sticker illustration, rich cel shading, clean varied dark outlines, expressive eyes. Square PNG sprite atlas, EXACTLY 3 columns by 3 rows, nine equal cells. Each portrait head and upper shoulders only, same size and center in its cell, occupy 68-72% of cell height with generous transparent margins on all four sides. Torso and shoulder outline FIXED forward-facing in every cell. Only the head turns, unchanged friendly calm expression. Row1: viewer upper-left, up, upper-right; row2: viewer left, forward, right; row3: viewer lower-left, down, lower-right. Clearly rotate face and nose, not just eyes. No hands, held props, text, labels, borders, grid lines, cast shadows, scenes or checkerboard. Genuine transparent alpha. Matching expressions atlas follows.
reactions: Use case: stylized-concept. Create the MATCHING EXPRESSIONS atlas of the ORIGINAL superhero Aster in the supplied directions sheet. Character: a gentle purple-skinned cosmic hero with short deep-blue hair dotted with tiny pale speckles, bright gold eyes, midnight-blue high-collar suit with a coral starflower badge. Copy the exact design, palette, clothing, outline weight, head proportions and scale of the reference center portrait. Exactly square 3x3 grid with equal cells, transparent alpha background, head and shoulders only. Every face points straight forward, torso and shoulders identical in shape, size, center and baseline to reference center cell. Character occupies 70% of each cell, wide clear margins including space for a small heart above head. Nine expressions in reading order: 1 blink closed curved eyes, 2 happy smile, 3 surprised round eyes O mouth, 4 affectionate face with one small floating red heart, 5 one-eye wink, 6 proud confident grin, 7 sleepy closed eyes, 8 dizzy spiral eyes, 9 laugh eyes closed open happy mouth. Robot eyes use expressive screen shapes where appropriate. No text, labels, grid lines, scenery, shadows, checkerboard. Nothing touches a cell edge. Genuine transparent PNG.
